title: Private Day of Dinosaurs & Hoodoos from Calgary to Badlands
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover the wonders of Alberta’s badlands on a day tour that takes you from prehistoric marvels to stunning natural landscapes. 
Start your journey at Horseshoe Canyon, a hidden gem known for its unique rock formations and rich geological history. Next go to the Royal Tyrell Museum in Drumheller, where you'll explore one of the world's most renowned collections of dinosaur fossils and interactive exhibits(Then you can have your lunch in the town or in the museum). Then, head to the iconic Hoodoos, where you'll be captivated by these fascinating geological formations that have been sculpted by wind and water over millions of years. Witness the world’s largest dinosaur and the beauty around it. 
Conclude your tour with a visit to the historic Rosedale Suspension Bridge, offering picturesque views and a touch of adventure as you cross the Red Deer River.
